title: Fender’s Latest Studio Must-Have Isn’t an Instrument — It’s a Candle: Shop the Guitar-Inspired Collection Here
summary: In collaboration with Voluspa, the new line of Fender candles features three distinct scents sold separately or as a three-piece set.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Your guitar doesn’t have to be the only thing setting the mood in your studio. Fender and Voluspa have teamed up on a collection of candles that bring Fender’s unmistakable instrument -inspired aesthetic into the recording room, rehearsal space or wherever you do your best work. The Voluspa x Fender Collection takes visual cues from Fender guitars , down to the color scheme and guitar pick motif on the front of each candle.

The collection includes the Fender Three Chord candle set featuring Midnight Leather , Vanilla Voltage and Strawberry Rush , priced at $70. Each scent is also available individually in an 11-ounce candle for $52 or a 4-ounce mini for $24. The candles are made with a coconut wax blend and natural wicks, and each one is handcrafted in California. They’re also vegan and free of sulfates, phthalates and parabens. Orders of $75 or more ship free.

3-PIECE SET

Fender Three Chord

$70

Buy Now at voluspa

The Fender Three Chord candle set pairs Midnight Leather, Vanilla Voltage and Strawberry Rush in three 4-ounce candles, each burning for about 25 hours. I received a sample of the Fender Three Chord and particularly loved the black guitar-case-inspired box with a handle that the trio came in.

Sophie Dunne/Billboard

SPICY

Midnight Leather

$52

Midnight Leather brings warm, spiced notes with ginger tonic, cardamom, worn leather and trails of incense. The rich fragrance feels made for late-night sessions and I especially love that it resembles the look of a Fender Standard Stratocaster . Available as an 11-ounce candle or a separately sold 3-ounce mini .

LIGHT AND AIRY

Vanilla Voltage

Vanilla Voltage turns up the sweetness with sparkling citrus, jasmine petals, whipped coconut milk and candy clouds. The scent comes in an 11-ounce candle or a separately sold 3-ounce mini option.

MOODY

Strawberry Rush

Strawberry Rush is bold and vibrant with mandarin, red hot strawberry, lychee liqueur and warm musk. Choose the 11-ounce candle or the separately sold 3-ounce mini .
